observation.visible_scene: A swimming pool filmed from near water level at sunset, with silhouetted hills and a warm orange sky behind. A jet of water arcs across the pool from left to right, forming a parabolic spray that lands near the middle of the pool where a couple of heads are visible; additional people stand at the right edge near a white structure. A dark blurred object (likely a hand or part of the camera housing) intrudes at the right edge and bottom, and the foreground shows rippling water.
visible_changes: The arcing water stream gradually lowers and flattens over the excerpt: its apex starts high in the frame and descends, and the left-side vertical splash plume at the jet's source shrinks and settles.
The spray texture thins as the clip progresses, with the early frames showing a broad droplet-filled arch and later frames showing a narrower, lower continuous stream.
The foreground water ripples and the blurred bottom object shift slightly, and the background hills/horizon move a little, indicating small camera bobbing or rotation rather than a large pan.
The people in the pool and at the right edge remain essentially in place, with only minor vertical bobbing relative to the water surface.
outside_clip_unknowns: What or who is producing the water jet and whether the stream is being intentionally lowered or simply losing pressure.
Whether the arc continues to fall or stabilizes after the last frame.
The full extent of the pool and the actions of the people before and after this segment.
uncertain_details: The exact direction and amount of camera motion (the background shifts are small and could be bobbing, tilt, or slight translation).
The identity of the blurred foreground/right-edge object (hand, arm, or camera housing).
Whether the apparent lowering of the arc is purely the water stream drooping or partly a change in camera angle.
